Backend Engineer
Finch Health, New York NY (hybrid)

About the role
Finch Health builds scheduling and records tools for outpatient clinics. You will design the APIs that clinics rely on every day.

Requirements
At least 4 years of backend engineering experience.
Strong Python skills in production services.
Hands-on experience building APIs with FastAPI.
Solid data modeling with PostgreSQL.
Experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes.

Nice to have
Event streaming experience with Kafka.

Responsibilities
Design and ship the scheduling API surface.
Own reliability for the records service.
Work with compliance on audit logging.
